name: Sherifdeen Raji
availability: Full-stack developer · open to freelance work
about: I'm Sherifdeen, a self-taught full-stack developer based in Nigeria. I learn by shipping: Balotly started as a question about how student elections could be fairer and became a live platform that ran SPEOAU's departmental election end to end.

With Brandboard I lead a small team building AI-assisted banner generation, from asset validation to export. I take on freelance work across web products and APIs — if you have an idea that needs building, I'd like to hear about it.

projects.name: Balotly
projects.description: Run student union, departmental, or association elections in minutes with no account needed up front. Voter tokens are 100% uncoupled from identity, and receipts are instantly verifiable.
projects.highlight: Ran SPEOAU's departmental election end to end.

projects.name: brandboard
projects.description: AI-assisted banner generation from a saved brand kit and short prompt. It validates assets, sanitizes deterministic HTML/CSS/SVG, tracks status, and lets users preview and export PNG or JPEG.
